subject: info-doc
title: INFO.DOC.------ACC.FT.
description: Diagram closing MP(II)-35 — the section on multi-national corporations as the fastest-developing piece of a greater progressional phenomenon of accelerated western functionalism. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'by solidifying accelerated functionalism in this context, western culture has moved to secure its hold on the total planet. The rise of multi-national corporations is only the fastest development of a much greater progressional phenomenon.' The crossing diagrams how information-documentation structurally meets accumulated-functionalism at the multi-national-corporation scale: INFO-DOC (information documentation — the documented information that supplies the form's working record) crossed with ACC-FT (accumulated functionalism — the receiving partner-axis that converts documentation into accelerated working). The diagram labels the central subject node with two stacked prefixes — (C)INFO-ACC (central information-accumulation) and (R)INT (the reality of intention) — indicating the subject side is the *intersection* of information-accumulation in its central form and intention in its reality form. INFO-DOC sits as title-axis subject; IST-ACT (isolated-source activism) sits at upper-left, RT-DY (reality dynamics) at upper-center, and ACC-FT at upper-right as the partner-axis upper outputs. RT-INT-TR (reality-internal transformation) sits at right with CN-INFO (continuance-information) below as partner-side outputs, and RT-T (reality-thrust) at the lower-right as the partner-side downward terminus. ALT-F (alternative form) sits at the left-center as the subject's leftward output. SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics) hangs at the lower-left with PHY-U-P (physical-universe particulars) at the bottom-left as the subject-side downward chain. POL-P (political particulars) sits at the lower-center and TRS (transformation) at the bottom-right as the bridging-axis downward chain. Structural argument: when information-documentation is crossed with accumulated-functionalism, the upper diagonal IST-ACT → RT-DY → ACC-FT → RT-INT-TR → CN-INFO → RT-T is the *multi-national-corporation route* — isolated-source activism routes through reality-dynamics into accumulated-functionalism, then through reality-internal transformation into continuance-information and finally into reality-thrust. This is the route by which multi-national corporations like ITT/General Motors actually accumulate functionalism — every edge in the chain is a corporate working step that converts the form's information-documentation into the partner's accelerated working. ALT-F → SOC-RT-DY → PHY-U-P on the subject-left is what information-documentation produces on its own — alternative-form routes through social-reality dynamics into physical-universe particulars. POL-P → TRS on the central-bottom is the bridging-axis downward chain: political-particulars routes into transformation. The structural argument: the multi-national-corporation rise the prose names is structurally the partner-axis's upper diagonal running through six edges without ever crossing into the subject's working chain — the third-world functionalism the prose mentions can only reach the form by holding the central subject-node's (C)INFO-ACC × (R)INT intersection open, which the upper diagonal structurally prevents.
